name: Install referrer
plain: The Play Store hands the app the campaign link that led to its install, readable for 90 days.
meaning: Tells an app which ad or link produced the install, with click and install timestamps. No permission is needed, so it is the standard Android attribution signal.

android.store_policy: Play: part of Play Services; referrer must be user safe
android.api_surface: InstallReferrerClient, ReferrerDetails (referrer URL, click and install timestamps, instant experience flag)
android.note: Click and install timestamps; 90 day read window; Meta and Huawei have their own referrers

ios.note: iOS uses SKAdNetwork or AdAttributionKit with coarse postbacks, and deferred deep links via clipboard or fingerprinting (discouraged)

limits.headline: Can learn which ad or link led to your install, for 90 days after
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens when you first open the app after installing from Google Play
can: Find the campaign link that led to your install
See the click and install times
Check it any time for 90 days
Use the Meta and Huawei versions on top of Google's
cannot: Work on iPhone; Apple has delayed anonymous reports instead
Give your name or contact details
limits.differs: Android only. iPhone uses delayed reports, and some apps use clipboard or fingerprint tricks Apple discourages.

story.what_it_is: Google Play hands an app the link that led to its install, so it knows which ad worked.

marketing.name: Play Install Referrer API
marketing.pitch: Securely retrieve the referral content from Google Play, such as which campaign led to the install.

story.for_you: You tap an ad, go to Play and install. The app wakes up and already knows which ad brought you, so it may show a welcome bonus.
story.for_makers: It needs no permission, includes click and install times, and stays readable for 90 days. It is the standard Android way to credit an ad and to power deferred deep links.

use_cases.example: A game reads the referrer and gives you the free gems from the ad you tapped.
A store app lands you on the sale page promised in the ad.
An ad network proves the install came from its ad and gets paid.
Fraud tools compare click and install times to catch click injection.
A friend invite link opens the right group after you install.
A growth team counts which referral campaign brings the best retention.

risks: Ties your install to an ad click
story.android_note: Android only. Available for 90 days after install.
story.ios_note: iOS has no equal. SKAdNetwork and AdAttributionKit fill the gap.

technical_bounds: Developer sets the referrer string through the Play URL

history.change: Server timestamps added for fraud detection
Broadcast deprecated; library v2 adds click-time fields
Install Referrer API introduced (replaces the broadcast)
